description: Fallow quality baseline. Counters may shrink but not grow; averageMaintainability may rise but not drop. Regenerate with `npm run check:quality -- --update` (commit the diff in the same PR that moves the metric). The do-date increment (PR #75) lowered averageMaintainability 91.8->91.7 — the reviewed reason is recorded in docs/Gaps.md GAP-74 (that entry's complexFunctions 13->15 bump was retired by a later refactor, per the same GAP). The Task Detail increment (PR #76) lowered it 91.7->91.6: adding the real async useTaskDetail composable (own MI 87.7, in line with its siblings useTaskSchedule 88.0 / useTaskReorderCommit 86.6 / useTaskDisplay 86.2 — not a factoring problem) pulls the repo-wide average down ~0.1 at this rounding edge; every counter metric (complexFunctions, cloneGroups, criticalComplexity, deadCode) stayed at/under baseline, single-sourcing shared field-reflection into utils/taskMutations.ts rather than duplicating.
